name: Da River fish
summary: Fish from the Đà River is one of the specialities Điện Biên’s culture director recommends, alongside bamboo worms, Mông wine, and mountain goat.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Nguyễn Minh Phú is quoted by Vietnam News on 28 Apr 2024.
howToEat: Vietnam News names Đà River fish among the province’s specialities.
seoTitle: Da River fish in Dien Bien Phu — named, no species
